title: Warburg Mulls $1 Billion Sale of London Insurance Broker McGill
summary: Warburg Pincus has held early talks with potential advisers about a sale of London insurance broker McGill and Partners, which could be valued around $1 billion.

title: Flora Food Group sale could spread $10bn KKR's way
summary: KKR is working with investment banks on a possible sale of Flora Food Group (formerly Upfield) at up to $10bn, the FT reported; a 2025 sale attempt to ADIA collapsed on price.

title: Affinity Is Said to Explore Selling Stake in Plaza Premium Group
summary: Affinity Equity Partners is exploring a sale of its stake in Hong Kong airport-lounge and hospitality firm Plaza Premium Group, Bloomberg reported.
